ownerOnly: Only the owner and admins change these settings. You can view them.
ownerOnlyActions: Only the owner can delete the business, transfer it or change the access code.

business.title: Business details
business.name: Name
business.typeHint: Optional (for example: corner store, cheese shop).
business.cutoffHint: Anything sold before this time counts for the previous day (default 02:00).
business.fixedHint: The country and currency are set when the business is created: changing them once there are sales would move the books.
business.countryHint: Sets the WhatsApp prefix for your customers.
business.currencyHint: 3-letter code (NIO, HNL, USD…). It can only change before the first sale.
business.currencyLocked: There are sales recorded in this currency: changing it would change the value of everything before, so it is fixed.

modules.title: Modules
modules.hint: Turn off what your business does not use: it is hidden in the app and the panel, nothing is deleted.

pos.title: Register
pos.hint: Tabs shown when selling. Keep at least one.
pos.registerCheckoutHint: Whoever serves builds the ticket and sends it to the register from the phone; anyone charges it later. For restaurants and bars.

credit.title: Credit
credit.requiresCustomer: Require a customer when selling on credit
credit.requiresCustomerHint: If off, typing a name is enough.
credit.limitEnforced: Block when the credit limit is exceeded
credit.dueDaysHint: A new credit sale is due in this many days. Empty = no change.

shifts.title: Shifts (legacy)
shifts.required: Require an open shift to sell
shifts.requiredHint: With no open shift the register asks to open one first.
shifts.noteHint: If the closing is off by more than this, whoever closes must explain it. Empty = no change.

templates.title: WhatsApp messages
templates.hint: This is how the messages shared with your customers read. You can change the text of each one, in each language.
templates.factory: The factory text is used. Write one to change it.
templates.unknown: These variables do not exist and will appear as typed: {{list}}

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.transferBody: Someone with a Google account becomes the owner of the business and you become an admin. There can only be one owner.
danger.noCandidates: There is nobody to transfer ownership to: you need an active member with a Google account (add them from Team).
danger.transferConfirmBody: {{name}} will own the business and you will become an admin. You cannot undo this on your own.
danger.deleteBody: The business is marked for deletion and stops being used. Data is permanently erased after 30 days; within that time you can ask for help to recover it.
danger.deleting: This business is marked for deletion. It will be permanently erased after 30 days; if it was a mistake, ask for help in Help and contact.
danger.deleteConfirmBody: Nobody will be able to keep selling or signing in. To confirm, type the business name.

formError.NAME: Enter the business name.
formError.CUTOFF: The cutoff time is not valid (HH:MM).
formError.POS_VIEWS: Keep at least one register tab.
formError.OVERDUE_DAYS: Days to count as overdue go from 1 to 365.
formError.SHIFT_NOTE: The amount is not valid for the currency.
formError.CURRENCY: The currency is a 3-letter code, like NIO or USD.

queue.title: Turn off register checkout?
queue.body_other: There are {{count}} tickets to collect at the register ({{amount}}). If you turn register checkout off, they will be cancelled. Turn it off?
queue.body_one: There are {{count}} ticket to collect at the register ({{amount}}). If you turn register checkout off, it will be cancelled. Turn it off?

err.REGISTER_QUEUE_BUSY: Someone is charging a ticket right now; try again in a moment.
err.INVALID_TIMEZONE: The time zone is not valid.
err.INVALID_DAY_CUTOFF: The cutoff time is not valid.
err.INVALID_POS_VIEWS: Keep at least one register tab.
err.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency can no longer change: there is activity recorded in it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Who did what in your business. Only you, as the owner, can see this list.
activity.platformNotice: Platform support looked at your business
activity.platformNoticeGeneric: The platform made a change to your business
activity.platformHint: This was done by the platform team and is recorded here so you know.

actions.platform_view_as: Platform support looked at your business
actions.platform_flag: The platform changed a business option
actions.platform_deletion_marked: The platform marked the business for deletion

dayRule.beforeSave: Applies from the next business day and won't change past days.
dayRule.dstTip: Your zone changes clocks in summer: a 04:00 cutoff is recommended, not 02:00.
dayRule.historyHint: The time zone and cutoff that applied in each period. Days already lived are not regrouped.
